about: Chat in the connection's code page: with langtype 5 (Thai) a line typed in Thai goes out in Windows-874 and comes back as Thai, on the chat window and over the head. In EUC-KR (langtype 0) Thai has no bytes, so it went out as HTML character references. A long line of Thai, which has no spaces between its words, fills its lines in the chat window and the balloon (it isn't sent down whole after the last space), with every vowel and tone mark on its letter and a tone mark above an upper vowel, not on it.
